div.div: ORDINAL ALIGNMENT INVARIANT — the passage ordinal is an explicit column from the chunker onward; every artifact (text shards, vectors, metadata) is sorted by it and verified monotone at each seam. S3 is the durable tier between phases; all long stages checkpoint per-segment and are spot-interruption safe.
